title: lithocardium tomentosum
intro: Lithocardium tomentosum, commonly known as Lithospermum tomentosum, is a plant species in the family Boraginaceae. It is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including hypertension and cardiovascular issues, due to its potential health benefits of lowering blood pressure and improving circulation, attributed to its therapeutic actions as a vasodilator and cardiac stimulant. The bioactive constituents of Lithocardium tomentosum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
